Package edu.secourse.service

Class UserService

java.lang.Object
edu.secourse.service.UserService
public class UserService extends Object
Service class responsible for managing User objects in-memory.

This class implements core business logic for user management, including:

  • Creating new users
  • Retrieving users (by ID or username)
  • Updating user information
  • Deleting users
  • Authentication and password management

Note: This implementation does not use a database. All user data is stored in an in-memory List, which means data will not persist after the application terminates.

This class is suitable for small applications, testing environments, or demonstration purposes.

  • Method Details

    • createUser

      public boolean createUser(User user)
      Creates and stores a new user.

      The user will only be added if no existing user shares the same username.

      Parameters:
      user - the user object to be added
      Returns:
      true if the user was successfully created, false if a user with the same username already exists
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if the provided user is null

    • getUsers

      public List<User> getUsers()
      Returns a list of all users.

      A defensive copy of the internal list is returned to prevent external modification of the service's internal state.

      Returns:
      a list containing all users

      public boolean updateUser(int id, String name, String email, String role)
      Updates an existing user's profile information.

      This method updates the user's name, email, and role based on the provided account ID.

      Parameters:
      id - the account ID of the user to update
      name - the new name
      email - the new email address
      role - the new role
      Returns:

    • authenticate

      public User authenticate(String username, String password)
      Authenticates a user using their username and password.

      The password is validated using the User.checkPassword(String) method, which compares the provided plaintext password with the stored hashed password.

      Parameters:
      username - the username
      password - the plaintext password
      Returns:
      true if authentication is successful, false otherwise

    • changePassword

      public boolean changePassword(String username, String oldPassword, String newPassword)
      Changes the password of a user.

      This method verifies the user's current password before applying the change. The password update is delegated to the User.changePassword(String, String) method.

      Parameters:
      username - the username of the user
      oldPassword - the current password
      newPassword - the new password
      Returns:
      true if the password was successfully changed, false if the user does not exist
      Throws:
      IllegalArgumentException - if password validation fails
